thread.title: Broadcom's ( AVGO ) recent dip is a great buying opportunity

author: David Zanoni
title: Broadcom's ( AVGO ) recent dip is a great buying opportunity
text:
Broadcom's ( AVGO ) recent dip is a great buying opportunity in my opinion. The company is a key player in the broad line semiconductor industry. Broadcom is set to benefit from its customer's growth and from acquisition growth. I expect the stock to thrive over the long-term as Broadcom continues to effectively manage its business.
The stock is trading at 8% to 9% off its 52-week highs. This will allow investors to buy the stock at a discount. The valuation is reasonable and should allow the stock to grow at a strong pace as the company achieves above-average earnings.
Broadcom has a list of high-profile customers with strong expected revenue growth. Here's a list of some of Broadcom's customers and their expected revenue growth for 2018:

As Broadcom's customers continue to grow, the company is set to benefit from the continuing industry growth. Broadcom's efforts to acquire businesses help add to the company's overall growth.
Segment Growth Broadcom is set to benefit from growth in the industry. Broadcom derives 45% of revenue from its Wired Infrastructure segment. This includes products for set-top boxes, Ethernet, WiFi, broadband, optics, etc. The mobile hotspot router market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 21% through 2021 . The global Ethernet switching market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 3% through 2021 . The global set-top box market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 2.8% through 2021 .
The company's second largest segment is Wireless Communication, which comprises 37% of Broadcom's revenue. This includes RF connectivity, LTE/cellular filters, Bluetooth, Global Navigation Satellite Systems [GNSS], and Touch technology. Global wireless sensors are projected to have a CAGR of 20% through 2021. That will help Broadcom's RF products.
